The researcher says the other keycard can be obtained from &bJackson&r in the &6military base&r.
The military keycard is required to gain access to the portal room, at which point the research keycard can be used to reactivate it.
I ran into a researcher at the C-70 Laboratory in the Wasteland.
The researcher says he was part of the &bContinuumCorp&r team that worked on opening the portal.

Despite the lack of thorough scouting, the corporation proceeded with colonization of the world on the other side — which would come back to haunt them a few years later when native life was discovered.
These creatures proceeded to overrun the &bAbyss&r settlements, and forced the &cemergency closure of the portals&r.
However, the act also caused a large percentage of the world's population to &cspontaneously mutate&r as well, perhaps due to them already being infected earlier.
The researcher &bbroadcast the cure&r sent by his colleagues in the Abyss across the Internet despite it being incomplete, hoping others would have time to finish the work they started.
He requires some materials to restore his &bresearch keycard&r, which should allow reactivation of the portal.
